name: BaseetIMS
tagline: Inventory management para sa maliliit na tindahan.
description:
## About BaseetIMS

BaseetIMS is an inventory management system designed for small shops — telecom counters, corner stores, and multi-location retailers who need real-time stock, sales, and cash flow in one place.

### Built for Small Shops

Track products, barcodes, and customers across every location. Run POS from the same dashboard, monitor flexiload and MFS commissions, and see what's due outstanding at a glance.

### One Dashboard, Every Shop

Switch between shops instantly. Revenue, cash collected, gross profit, and commission numbers update as you move — so owners always know where they stand.

## Ready to Streamline Your Shop?

Contact us for a demo tailored to your business.

hero.title: Patakbuhin ang Bawat Tindahan mula sa Isang Dashboard
hero.subtitle: Inventory, POS, flexiload commissions, daily sales — para sa maliliit na tindahan.

features.title: Multi-Shop Dashboard
features.description: Switch between locations and watch revenue, cash collected, gross profit, and due outstanding update in real time.

features.title: Inventory & POS
features.description: Barcode scanning, stock alerts, low-stock warnings, and a full POS terminal — all connected to the same ledger.

features.title: Flexiload & MFS
features.description: Track flexiload and mobile financial service commissions alongside product sales in one daily summary.

features.title: Sales Trends
features.description: Seven-day line charts, overdue case tracking, and backup status — see patterns before they become problems.

features.title: Customer Ledger
features.description: Due outstanding, overdue cases, and payment history per shop — know who owes what at a glance.

features.title: Reports & Alerts
features.description: Stock transfers, audit logs, user permissions, and configurable alerts for low stock and overdue payments.

faq.question: What types of shops is BaseetIMS built for?
faq.answer: BaseetIMS is designed for small retail shops — telecom counters, libraries, convenience stores, and multi-location businesses that need inventory, POS, and commission tracking in one place.

faq.question: Can I manage multiple shop locations?
faq.answer: Yes. Switch between shops from the dashboard sidebar. Revenue, cash collected, profit, and due outstanding update per location.

faq.question: Does it support flexiload and MFS commissions?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Flexiload and mobile financial service commissions are tracked alongside product sales in your daily summary.

faq.question: Is there a demo available?
faq.answer: Contact us for a personalized walkthrough. We tailor onboarding to your shop's workflow.
